title: feature_pipeline/1: the operation of the pipeline of mzFinder in an mzflow/1 file
description: One entry of `operazioni` of a .mzflow (mzlab/web/workflow.js, KNOWN_OPS). It carries everything needed to re-apply the pipeline on the same files and get the same .mzfeat: the recipe with the proof of every estimated value, the version of the engine, the SHA-256 of the inputs and of the table, the rules and levels used and the register of the hypotheses. Written by TP_Mine/js/35_pipeline_recipe.js.

crate_version.description: version of mzlab-feat inside the .wasm that ran

recipe.description: the exact text of the recipe (JSON) given to the engine

parametri.description: the recipe parsed: polarity, mode, floor (absent = estimated by the engine), min_height, min_points, ppm, rt_tol, fill

prove.description: the proofs of the estimated values (histogram, point chosen, sigma, number of points); null when no preview was made

genitore.description: the parent of the hypotheses (null = no proofs, only the table)

tabella_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the .mzfeat of the series (with the section evid when there is a parent)

sospetti.description: index of the suspects; null when absent

ipotesi.description: register of the hypotheses (ipotesi/1): searched, found and hash of its JSON

normalizza.description: parameters of the `normalizza` operation (mzlab-feat norm.rs, Method::to_json): the normalisation is a view over the table, the .mzfeat keeps the measured areas

istd.description: only with metodo istd: the row by `id`, or the row nearest to `mz` and `rt` (within `ppm` and `rt_tol`)

filtra.description: parameters of the `filtra` operation (filters.rs): an ordered list of rules; a row is rejected by the first rule it fails
